_comment: Source of truth for the positions page. Hand-edited when a position is opened or closed; build.py adds the live price and derives R. The thesis is written AT ENTRY - a thesis composed at exit is marking your own homework, and the whole point of the page is that the claim was on the record before the outcome was.
_symbol_note: Yahoo symbols. Japan 225 uses NIY=F, the yen Nikkei future, NOT ^N225: the spot index closes with Tokyo while CMC's cash CFD tracks the future, so ^N225 reads about 0.8% away from the platform and puts the stop distance visibly wrong.
_r_note: 1R is the distance from entry to the initial stop. Every outcome on this page is quoted in multiples of it, so positions of different sizes are comparable.

open.name: GBP/CHF
open.thesis: Sterling pays 3.75% a year and the franc pays nothing. This earns the difference for doing nothing.
open.catalyst: Opened nine days before the September MPC, with the market pricing a rise rather than a cut.
open.breaks: The Bank of England starts cutting, or the SNB stops selling francs into a rally.

open.name: Japan 225
open.thesis: Two chip stocks drive the Nikkei: Advantest and Tokyo Electron explain three quarters of its daily moves. Buying the index buys them.
open.catalyst: Opened three weeks before the cap rule cuts Advantest's weight on 1 October. Passive funds must buy the rest of the index.
open.breaks: Advantest and Tokyo Electron roll over. Nothing else in the index is big enough to hold it up.

open.name: USD/MXN
open.thesis: Mexico pays 6.50% a year and the United States pays 3.75%. Holding pesos earns the gap.
open.catalyst: The peso had been strengthening for three months and hit a one-year high the day before this went on.
open.breaks: Banxico starts cutting, or the crowd holding pesos sells at once.

_thesis_note: thesis: how the position earns, and nothing else - the risk belongs in breaks, or it gets said twice. Caps: thesis 24 words, catalyst 22, breaks 20. See the position-thesis skill.
_dp_note: dp is DISPLAY precision only. The stored entry and stop keep their full precision, so R and the distance to the stop are unaffected by it.
_ccy_note: ccy is what the PRICE is quoted in: for a cross that is the quote currency (the second one), for an index the currency of the index.
_sources_note: Slot facts as at 10/09/2026. Policy rates confirmed on Bloomberg: UKBRBASE 3.75, SZLTDEP 0.00, MXONBR 6.50, FDTR 3.75. Nikkei weights and the cap from Nikkei Inc's own review announcement; the 73% figure is measured from Yahoo daily closes. Re-check before quoting any of them.
